resolution: Handled selected placed-item rotation in the iso authoring builder. Current IsoAuthor now uses R mode-sensitively: armed placement still rotates the ghost, and with no armed tool it rotates the current selection. Whole-building selections rotate through one buildingMoved yaw update; loose pieces use the existing remove+place world-stream path with yawDegrees +90 while preserving placement metadata. Added the REQ-0598 capture note. Verified direct IsoAuthor bundle, build-snap 19/19, and full hmsc-int cart bundle.
